name: 市场与渠道策略
Market & channel strategy
rows: 成熟渠道提升单店产出
facts: 10.01–10.11固定监测门店2,400家；份额=HC四款商品销量÷监测店同类包装饮料销量。广东12.8%、浙江15.2%，不外推全国。
Oct1–11 fixed panel of2,400 stores; share=four HC-product units / same-category packaged-drink units in monitored stores. Guangdong12.8%, Zhejiang15.2%; no national extrapolation.
广东样本铺货率68%，浙江82%；不能只比较总销量。
Panel distribution: Guangdong 68%, Zhejiang 82%; total sales alone misleads.
将区域目标拆到渠道和SKU，区分现有网点动销与新增铺货。
Separate existing-store velocity from new distribution by channel/SKU.
评估新增有效网点和持续动销，不以发货代替消费。
Evaluate active distribution and sustained sell-out, not just shipments.
insight: 广东份额低同时铺货不足，先核渠道覆盖；浙江更适合测试单店效率。两地不应使用同一增长动作。
Low share with limited distribution suggests coverage work in Guangdong; Zhejiang warrants store-productivity trials. The growth actions differ.

name: 产品与包装生命周期
Product & packaging lifecycle
facts: 覆盖即饮和家庭分享两种消费场景，不能只保留500mL一个规格。
Cover on-the-go and family sharing, not a single 500mL pack.
四个销售SKU分别维护配方、瓶型、纸箱/包膜与生效版本。
Four SKUs maintain recipe, bottle, carton/film and effective versions.
试制批次P-061：包装完整性待复核；上市不自动批准。
Pilot P-061 awaits packaging-integrity review; launch is not approved.
包材改版影响库存消耗、采购合同及灌装线换型。
Packaging changes affect obsolete stock, contracts and line changeovers.
insight: 先冻结新增旧版采购评审，比较分阶段切换、消耗与报废成本；新品预测扣除老品替代量。
Review new old-pack purchases; compare phased transition, consumption and write-off; deduct cannibalization from launch demand.

name: 产销协同与需求计划
Integrated demand & supply
facts: 基准108＋净活动增量12＝120万箱；已接订单属于计划，不再次叠加。
108 baseline + 12 net promotion uplift = 120 (10k cases); orders are included, not added twice.
可供112万箱，缺口8万箱；质量隔离3万箱不计可售。
Supply 112, gap 8 (10k cases); 30k quality-held cases are excluded.
广东同SKU缺4万箱；35万元增量现金约束下比较跨区方案。
Guangdong has a 40k-case SKU gap; compare plans under a CNY350k cash cap.
尚未下达追加计划；需批准方案及核实可调库存/产能。
No additional plan released; approval and stock/capacity checks are pending.
insight: 按SKU×地点×渠道×周核对偏差；缺货销量作为受限观察，分开处理天气、活动和渠道补库存。
Review SKU/location/channel/week bias; treat stockout sales as censored observations; separate weather, promotion and pipeline fill.

name: 供应商生命周期
Supplier lifecycle
facts: 新供应商需质量及交付能力评审，价格不是唯一条件。
New suppliers need quality and delivery assessment, not price alone.
纸箱双供70/30，备用份额不能视为立即可用产能。
Cartons have 70/30 sourcing; backup share is not instant capacity.
PK-018延交与包装线等待相关，需核实订单级原因。
PK-018 delays align with packaging waits; investigate order-level causes.
整改关闭前不扩大关键SKU的依赖。
Do not increase critical-SKU dependency before corrective actions close.
insight: 履约评估同时看准时、足量与质量；备供须核准入、产能及价格有效期后才能切换。
Assess timeliness, quantity and quality; verify alternative approval, capacity and price validity before switching.

name: 采购到付款
Procure to pay
facts: BOM依SKU/包装版本展开，瓶数和包材损耗分别计算。
Explode by SKU/pack version, with separate bottle counts and packaging loss.
6万纸箱晚于原计划1天；复核是否影响广东加产窗口。
60k cartons are one day late; check the Guangdong production window.
包膜到货8吨仍待检验，不能作为已放行齐套物料。
8 tonnes of film remain on inspection hold, not released supply.
PO/收货/发票存在1笔数量差异；采购和财务共同处理。
One order/receipt/invoice quantity mismatch needs purchasing and finance.
insight: 将欠料与工单开工、替代包材生效版本及供应商承诺关联，避免重复下单。
Link shortages to production starts, effective alternative packs and supplier promises; prevent duplicate orders.

name: 原辅包材与库存
Ingredients & packaging
facts: 物理入库与质量放行分开，仓位不决定可用状态。
Physical receipt and release differ; location does not determine availability.
临期原料6吨，按订单配方及客户成品效期约束消耗。
6 tonnes near expiry require recipe and finished-goods shelf-life checks.
批次投料须追溯到工单，超领损耗独立记录。
Lot issues link to work orders; excess consumption is separate.
盘点差异0.3吨待复核，不能由建议自动改账。
A 0.3-tonne count variance awaits review; recommendations cannot change the ledger.
insight: 先按质量、效期和已承诺用量计算可用量，再联动排产、FEFO与采购延期。
Calculate availability after quality, shelf life and commitments; coordinate production, FEFO and purchase deferral.

name: 制造与委外协同
Manufacturing & co-packing
facts: SKU箱规转换为升数/瓶速/换型工时，不能把万箱直接当统一产能。
Convert SKU cases into liters, line rate and changeover hours.
投料批RM-1001→产出批FG-1011，过程偏差须单独调查。
Input RM-1001 links to output FG-1011; investigate deviations separately.
纸箱与包膜各有包装参数，五类码按对象关系绑定。
Carton and film use different pack settings; codes link to their objects.
L2效率71%，停机损失不能用理论速度抹平。
L2 OEE is 71%; theoretical speed cannot erase downtime losses.
insight: 按产线适配、换型/CIP、包材与班次比较排程，维护窗口和质量放行为硬约束。
Compare line compatibility, changeover/CIP, packaging and shifts; respect maintenance and quality release.

name: 质量、放行与召回
Quality, release & recall
facts: 来料、过程、成品检验分层；检验完成不等于已批准放行。
Incoming, in-process and finished tests differ; completion is not release.
一例投诉尚不能证明同批缺陷，需留样、运输与门店条件交叉核查。
One complaint does not prove a batch defect; compare samples and handling.
3万箱待检/隔离不得计入可售或调拨候选。
30k held cases cannot enter saleable supply or transfer options.
追溯范围按批次和实际分发记录，缺少箱级证据时保留批次范围。
Use batch/distribution scope; missing case evidence remains batch-level.
insight: 关联原料、产线、留样与投诉划定影响范围；质量结论由授权责任人确认。
Link inputs, line, retains and complaints to scope impact; authorized quality owner confirms disposition.

name: 仓网、效期与调拨
Warehouse network & allocation
facts: 可用、已承诺、安全余量不混用；经销商库存不自动归品牌所有。
Available, committed and reserve differ; distributor stock is not automatically ours.
按客户最低剩余效期筛选批次，再按先到期先出分配。
Filter by customer minimum shelf life before FEFO allocation.
湖北最多调2万箱，调4万会侵占本地承诺或安全余量。
Hubei can release at most 20k cases; 40k breaches commitments/reserve.
退回0.4万箱进入隔离，不自动恢复可售。
4k returned cases enter quarantine, not saleable inventory.
insight: 比较制造、包材、换型、运输、检验、持有/损耗成本与现金，排除未获质量放行的代工。
Compare manufacturing, materials, setup, freight, inspection, holding/loss and cash; exclude unapproved co-pack supply.

name: 运输、签收与逆向
Transport, delivery & returns
facts: 按重量/体积/托盘及箱规约束装载，不能只按箱数满载。
Loading respects weight, cube, pallets and pack dimensions, not case count alone.
在途不重复算作仓内可用量，预计到货和已签收分开。
Transit is not on-hand inventory; ETA is not proof of delivery.
广东228/250到期订单按时足量＝91.2%；逾期需定位到客户承诺。
228/250 Guangdong orders due were OTIF = 91.2%; trace misses to commitments.
拒收、破损、召回与可回收托盘分别管理，返仓后先判状态。
Separate refusal, damage, recall and returnable pallets; assess status on receipt.
insight: 跨区调拨要核到货窗口，否则库存移动也不能兑现客户交期。
Transfers must meet arrival windows; moving stock alone does not meet customer dates.

name: 渠道订单到回款
Channel order to cash
facts: 信用额度、价格条款和区域授权共同约束接单。
Credit, price terms and territory authorization constrain orders.
已接订单60万箱属于120万箱需求计划，不再次相加。
600k ordered cases are included in the 1.2m demand plan.
发运、签收、开票和收入按企业既定口径分开。
Shipment, receipt, invoice and revenue follow distinct company rules.
KA促销扣款须匹配活动履约及费用计提，不能直接认定坏账。
Match retailer deductions to promotion performance/accruals before classifying debt.
insight: 发货增长未必是消费增长。应结合渠道库存天数与覆盖门店动销，识别压货而非扩大激励。
Shipment growth may be channel loading. Compare inventory days and sampled sell-out before increasing incentives.

name: 营销、促销与结算
Marketing, promotions & settlement
facts: 同一活动队列：12万潜客、3.6万有效兴趣、0.72万去重下单客户；订单数单独记录。
Same campaign cohort:120k prospects,36k qualified,7.2k unique purchasers; order counts are separate.
广东活动先确保门店可得性；缺货时追加流量可能加剧损失。
Secure Guangdong availability before adding demand through promotion.
客户索赔须匹配活动执行证据和计提，不把预算等同付款。
Match claims to performance and accruals; budget is not payment.
会员30日复购率按同批次可观察顾客计算；活动归因仍需对照。
30-day repeat uses an observable cohort; campaign attribution still needs control.
insight: 先核可得性、信用与适用触达，再比较活动、渠道和SKU的净贡献；保留对照组。
Check availability, credit and contact eligibility; compare net contribution by campaign/channel/SKU with holdouts.

name: 客户、会员与售后
Customer, loyalty & service
facts: 扫码兑奖与销售事件分开，扫码量不能直接作为销量。
Reward scans and sales differ; scan count is not sales volume.
消费者画像以获准触点和同意范围构建，不硬连相机身份。
Profiles use authorized touchpoints, not assumed camera identity.
投诉关联批次不等于质量缺陷已证实，服务与质量调查并行。
Batch linkage does not prove a defect; service and quality review proceed together.
售后主题进入产品改进评审，复购按可观察顾客群追踪。
Service themes feed product reviews; track repeat within observable cohorts.
insight: 区分经销商、KA组织、门店与个人会员；将信用、服务与供货风险合并为下一步经营建议。
Separate distributors, KA organizations, outlets and members; combine credit, service and supply risk into next actions.

name: 财务、现金与经营绩效
Finance, cash & performance
facts: 毛销售5200－折扣返利260－退货80＝净销售4860万元。
Gross5200 − discounts260 − returns80 = net4860 (CNY10k).
销售与回款存在账期差；渠道零售流水不并入品牌收入。
Sales and collection dates differ; retailer takings are not brand revenue.
期初现金1800＋收款4200－经营支付3680－资本支出120＝2200万元。
Opening1800 + collections4200 − operating payments3680 − capex120 = closing2200 (CNY10k).
净销售4860－成本3260＝毛利1600；毛利不等于净利润或现金。
Net sales4860 − COGS3260 = gross profit1600; not net profit or cash.
insight: 预算35万元是本次追加方案上限，不是集团现金余额；现金足够也不代表费用已获批。
The CNY350k cap applies to this incremental plan, not group cash; cash availability is not spending authorization.

name: 组织、人力与资产
People, capacity & assets
facts: 计划480工时，可用432工时；包装班组尚缺两个班次确认。
480 hours planned, 432 available; two packaging shifts await confirmation.
维护窗口与排产共同安排，不能用满负荷计划覆盖停机。
Respect maintenance windows in production plans.
薪酬应付/实付与折旧分开，固定资产采购另列现金。
Separate wages accrued/paid, depreciation and capex cash.
改善任务6项，已核验关闭2项；其余4项由运营负责人跟进。
Six improvement actions; two verified closed, four tracked by operations.
insight: L2维护与追加排产存在窗口冲突；生产、设备与采购须在14:00前联合确认班次和包材。
L2 maintenance conflicts with extra production. Production, maintenance and purchasing must confirm shifts and materials by 14:00.

Vietnam

risk: 到港提柜晚于原计划12小时，0.5万箱需求缺口待协调。

Thailand

risk: 促销订单增加0.5万箱，补货批次待确认。

action: 海外销售 / 计划负责人 · 今日17:00复核促销承诺
International sales / planning · review campaign commitments by 17:00

Malaysia
route: 华南 → 巴生港 → 区域配送
risk: 本周可供覆盖需求；核对到仓数量与渠道签收。
Weekly supply covers demand; reconcile receiving and channel deliveries.
action: 海外物流 · 明日12:00完成收货差异复核
International logistics · reconcile receipts by tomorrow 12:00

name: 印度尼西亚
Indonesia
route: 华东 → 丹戎不碌 → 雅加达配送
risk: 两票订单交期承压，剩余效期与分拨窗口需同时满足。
Two orders at risk; shelf life and distribution windows must both hold.
action: 海外业务 / 质量负责人 · 今日16:00确认批次与窗口
International / quality leads · confirm lots and windows by 16:00

name: 阿联酋
United Arab Emirates
route: 华南 → 杰贝阿里 → 海湾经销网络
risk: 本周需求缺口0.5万箱；10.22到港船货不能计入本周供给。
5k-case weekly gap; the Oct22 arrival is outside this week’s supply window.
action: 区域总经理 · 今日18:00确认订单优先级
Regional GM · confirm order priorities by 18:00

name: 澳大利亚
Australia
route: 华东 → 墨尔本 → 零售配送
risk: 本周由当地库存保供；下一批出口包装已完成复核。
Local stock covers this week; next shipment packaging review complete.
action: 海外物流 · 10.13核对装箱单与装船计划
International logistics · reconcile packing list and loading plan Oct13

name: 便利与即时消费
Convenience
rows: 门店复核后同步售卖状态
insight: 先恢复冷柜有货与可售状态，再追加流量。门店缺货与冰柜故障分开派单，区域销售、配送与设备主管共同负责。
Restore cold stock and available-to-sell status before adding traffic. Separate replenishment from cooler repairs across sales, delivery and asset leads.

name: 餐饮与酒店娱乐
Foodservice & hospitality
rows: 交付与回收同路线闭环
insight: 订单增长先核对宴席与单店动销，识别前置备货。服务成本、设备投入和返利共同影响客户贡献，不能仅按发货量加奖励。
Validate order growth against bookings and outlet consumption. Service cost, equipment and rebates all affect account contribution before incentives increase.

name: 商超与会员仓店
Modern retail
insight: 促销动销、门店缺货和扣款联动评估。增加铺货须同时检查渠道库存、退货条款与净贡献，先关闭未核实扣款。
Link promotional sell-out, shelf availability and claims. Review channel stock, return terms and contribution before increasing distribution.

name: 传统零售与经销
Traditional retail
insight: 发货增长与终端动销分开看。信用不足、库存偏高或区域异常时，分别协调回款、补货节奏与核查，不能把压货当增长。
Separate sell-in from outlet sell-out. Resolve credit, excess stock and territory exceptions through collections, replenishment cadence and investigation.

name: 电商与品牌直营
E-commerce & DTC
rows: 核履约成本及会员复购
insight: 平台GMV、平台买断和品牌直营收入分别计量。直播活动先查可承诺库存、退货及费用后的贡献，再决定投流和组合装。
Separate platform GMV, wholesale and brand-direct revenue. Evaluate available-to-promise stock, returns and contribution after fees before campaign spend.

name: 团购与机构
Institutional
rows: 按日历调整节假日备货
客户经理跟进签收与续约
insight: 以合同交付与回款质量判断续约，区分固定消耗与活动突增；避免将一次性团购外推为长期需求。
Base renewal on service and collections. Separate recurring consumption from events when forecasting future demand.

water: 随身补水、家庭囤货与机构饮用分开预测
Separate on-the-go hydration, home stocking and institutional use
小包装看冷饮可得性，大包装看重量/运费与配送频率
Small packs: cold availability; large packs: weight, freight and delivery frequency
soft: 单人即饮、佐餐与家庭分享，分别配置规格和促销
Match packs and promotion to single-serve, meals and sharing
冷柜、现调设备与包装渠道分别管理
Manage coolers, fountain equipment and packaged channels separately
juice: 早餐、餐饮与家庭场景；常温/冷藏产品分别规划
Breakfast, foodservice and home; distinguish ambient and chilled products
保鲜与冷链按产品要求配置，不能对所有果汁统一套用
Preservation and cold-chain requirements are product-specific
tea: 单瓶即饮、佐餐大瓶与家庭装，分场景跟踪动销
Track single-serve, meal-pairing and family-pack consumption separately
冷饮可得性与新品替代一起评估；常温运输不等于必须全程冷链
Assess cold availability and cannibalization; chilled serving does not imply a cold transport chain
energy: 运动、通勤与工作时段；结合网点和时段的补货节奏
Replenish by outlet and sports, commuting or work dayparts
小包装、陈列位置与营销触点联动，功效表述按已批准版本
Coordinate small packs, placement and approved messaging
beer: 餐饮/夜场、赛事与家庭场景分开；瓶罐与桶装分别预测
Separate hospitality, events and home; forecast bottles/cans versus kegs
冷饮设备、桶装酒管路服务、周转桶瓶与押金、适用营销限制
Track dispense service, keg/bottle returns, deposits and applicable marketing restrictions

按授权与价值选择唤回
coreNodes: 新品→试制→上市→复盘→退出

先冻结新增旧版采购评审，比较分阶段切换、消耗与报废成本；新品预测扣除老品替代量。
Review new old-pack purchases; compare phased transition, consumption and write-off; deduct cannibalization from launch demand.
产品负责人 / 采购 / 质量
渠道信号→基准→活动/新品→共识
基准108万箱＋净增量12万箱＝120万箱；计划可供112万箱。

按SKU×地点×渠道×周核对偏差；缺货销量作为受限观察，分开处理天气、活动和渠道补库存。
